verdict.rationale: Perplexity has a dedicated rate-limits and usage-tiers docs page. It describes a self-serve upgrade path: spending more on pay-as-you-go API credits automatically moves you to higher tiers with more requests per minute, and tiers are never downgraded. The evidence does not show the actual per-tier limit values, and nothing documents concurrency caps. Missing for 10: concrete published RPM/token limits per tier, documented concurrency caps, independent corroboration.
